title: Block
description: One unit of a scene's manuscript text, in reading order: a narration or a line of dialogue.

narration.description: Prose the narrator tells: action, description, a character's thoughts. It follows the manuscript's language, voice and tense.

text.description: The prose, as plain text. Paragraphs are separated by a blank line.

dialogue.description: One character's spoken line: the words spoken, with tone cues where the delivery changes.

speaker.description: The character who speaks, by the name the story gives them.

oneOf.description: Words the speaker says, without quotation marks.
How the speaker says the words that follow, such as "whispering" or "with a bitter laugh".
